page.overview:
What is Codgers' Quarry?

Codgers' Quarry is an abandoned quarry located northwest of Stonecutters' Settlement. It is used by a local group of bandits to ambush wandering explorers looking for easy loot.

There is a missable event which will only occur if you approach the residents with your weapons sheathed.
